name: click-tracking
description: Click tracking analytics - the link grid, one link's detail page, and the sources view (SWR-11033)
//startUrl: Salesmessage takes always start at the app entry, /conversations/, not the target's default.
resolvedBy: observed live in Chrome via the Claude in Chrome extension, admin session on app.salesmessage.com
intro: Click tracking | See who clicks the links you send
outro: Thanks for watching | Questions? Reach out any time - we are happy to help
//outro: the standard Salesmessage outro, as in sample/enhance-agent-instructions.mp4
warnings:
The prepared link is short code NIqoQk (https://salesmsg.org/NIqoQk, Campaign 'Analytics Campaign', 3 clicks, link id 834033).
If that link is deleted or the account changes, update the type step and re-walk.
The Contacts tab shows the recipient's real name, phone number and email on camera. Use a demo contact before publishing.

Search is debounced: the grid empties, then the single match returns ~1.4s after the last keystroke.
The old rows match `gridRow` until then, so the take waits on `gridOneRow` (tbody tr:only-child) instead.

Load times vary a lot: Sources 0.8s-11.9s, the Overview grid 1.5s-8.8s, the detail page 0.85s-3.5s, and twice the app stalled outright
(Sources empty for 32s+, the detail page spinning 10s+). Timeouts are sized from the slow loads; if a take aborts on a wait, check the app before changing the script.
The Aircall 'integration disconnected' banner across the top is hidden by the target's hideSelectors.

A 'Plan credits exceeded!' alert pops up bottom-left in profile/ about 11s after load and stays for the whole take.
One 1s ifAppears guard at 'Find one link' (~30s in) closes it; if it shows, it is on screen from ~11s until then.
Closing it snoozes it for 30 days in profile/ (localStorage subscription_credits_alert_closed_at_<user>), so usually the guard does not fire.
No guard at the start: the take begins ~3s after load, before the alert can appear, and a start guard only adds a frozen, silent opening (failed qa twice).

ready.evidence: 1 match; app aria-label convention NavLink_*. Part of the app shell. Appeared 2.9s after loading /conversations/

creditsAlert.intent: the 'Plan credits exceeded!' alert in the bottom-left corner
creditsAlert.evidence: 1 match in profile/ on /conversations/, inside div[aria-label=Alert]; appeared 11.5s after load. Not shown in the user's own Chrome (snoozed there)

creditsAlertClose.intent: the close (x) button on the 'Plan credits exceeded!' alert
creditsAlertClose.evidence: button inside the same Alert as the title (Alert_IconClose > IconButtonAlertClose). Scoped with :has so no other Alert's close can match

navAnalytics.intent: the Analytics icon in the far-left app sidebar

colSent.evidence: 1 match, text 'Sent'. Headings carry no aria-label/testid, only scope=col; column order Target URL, Short URL, Source, Sent, Clicks, Unique clicks, Unique click rate, Credits per click, Inbox, Created at

colClicks.intent: the Clicks column heading in the overview grid

colUnique.intent: the Unique clicks column heading in the overview grid

colRate.evidence: 1 match, text 'Unique click rate' (truncated on screen at 1440 wide)

gridOneRow.intent: the overview grid holding exactly one row, after a search narrows it
gridOneRow.evidence: the page's only table: 3 rows unfiltered (no match), 0 while the search spinner shows, 1 after NIqoQk (1 match, verified live). Not scoped to div[aria-label=TableClickTrackingOverviewTable]: that wrapper exists only while loading, which made the first scoped spec time out mid-take. A plain row wait passed instantly on the stale rows

search.intent: the search box above the overview grid
search.evidence: the only input on the page; no aria-label or name. Filters by short code

rowOpen.intent: the Unique clicks cell of the first grid row, which opens the link's detail page
rowOpen.evidence: cursor:pointer, x=1225 of 1463; click navigates to /analytics/click-tracking/overview/834033 (verified 2026-10-19). Chosen over the Source cell (col 3) so the click zoom pans right and keeps the figure columns in frame. Never the Short URL cell (col 2) - a live link that would register a click
